in_sanskrit.name: Karthikeya
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of War, Son of Lord Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kart- meaning to create, Rish- God, keya- Lord, so Karthikeya is the one who creates the gods.

in_hindi.name: कर्तिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: कर्तनात् कर्तक: कर्तक, वाक्यकार्ता, अथवा शिवालयवर कृष्णार्पणमें प्रसाद दिलानेवाला कृपालु

in_marathi.name: Karthik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Agriculture
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karthik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Karthik is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu deity Lord Karthikeya. He is considered the god of agriculture, fertility, and war. He is also known as the lord of virtues and wisdom.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Agriculture
